title: 18.7. Hetuduka, Mahantaradukādi
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Hetuṁ sārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nahetu nasārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ anārammaṇaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanahetu naanārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nahetuṁ cittaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanahetu nocitto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
